object_description: Low rectangular hall with a shed-lit upper platform
design_condition: Placed south of the perimeter parallel to the hospital extension, the building clarifies the campus organization and forms triangular and rectangular green spaces connected by two soft-mobility axes.

positive.statement: The precise location generates quality green spaces around the construction.
The two precisely laid out soft-mobility axes connect the building to other campus facilities.
The peripheral gallery offers exterior extensions and addresses fire-safety issues.
The layout of the program is logical and rational.
The building offers great flexibility in distributing the program across its levels.
The construction system allows a possible future extension to be considered with confidence.
The shed roof provides excellent natural lighting and good potential for photovoltaic electricity production.

negative.statement: The industrial expression evokes a knowledge factory, but its somewhat literal treatment requires nuance.
The proposal is not part of the family of truly compact projects.
The consumption of gray energy appears relatively high, partly because of the heavily glazed facades and the two-and-a-half-level distribution.
A significant improvement could be obtained by guaranteeing the use of recycled glass and steel.
